hypothesis: A cue quality scalar per FPN level cannot learn location-dependent auxiliary selection. Test a spatial gate with a newly learned current-November-cue pyramid rather than the historical causal_cache or a frozen RGB encoder applied to IR. Existing teacher-confidence spatial protection remains; this is not evidence that its absence caused old failures.

architecture.comparison: Separate trainable RGB/native1x1 projections, per-location channel RMS normalization; concatenate R,I,abs(R-I),R*I. This comparison is between learned projected spaces, not raw channelwise RGB and IR sensor equivalence.
architecture.spatial: 1x1 conv,SiLU,depthwise3x3,SiLU,1x1 scalar map; final weights/bias zero. logit(frame_quality)+spatial_delta, or zero global logit in spatial-only.
architecture.redundancy: abs(R-I),R*I ->1x1 hidden16,SiLU,1x1,sigmoid; last weights0,bias-6. effective gate=gate*(1-rho). Near-disabled at addition, not exactly unchanged after loading a nonzero parent.
architecture.residual: Same zero-initialized native output projection, bound0.5*RGB_RMS*tanh(projection), existing teacher-confidence protection and valid mask. No RGB/head/BN update.
architecture.missing: Current cue absent returns RGB exactly without reading cue; no state or memory; malformed chronological state is rejected.

CPU.order: Same six source addresses and initial weights for each of9variant/cue groups. Frozen RGB features may be shared only in RAM for this engineering check; no formal performance or budget claim.
CPU.inference: After actual updates: full head zero-init and unavailable equality, partial availability, spatial-gate gradient/variation, and actual IR-image-roll observation. This check is Train-only and not a tracking accuracy test.

formal_remaining.stage_order: Three matched spatial-only fits and complete normal Dev, then quality+spatial, then redundancy; no simultaneous introduction of all enabled mechanisms.
formal_remaining.budget: All nine normal fits execute the same total full-Train budget; stage extension after all required complete Dev curves, using fixed same native-study0.2 criterion. A stage is not a sparse cached pass.
formal_remaining.selection: Freeze complete Dev-only primary and all matched controls before Test. No Test-based replacement or triggering.
